D.752

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 752
Date 29 - 1 - 30

January 29, 30.

Dear Colonel,

I have to acknowledge receipt of
your letter, dated December 10, 1929, and to
inform you that inquiries made have failed to
locate a publication in Nanking or elsewhere in
China known as the "Far Eastern Information Bureau
Bulletin".

Yours sincerely,

〔此处转录不清〕

Lieut. Col.G.M.R. Halland,O.B.E.,

1930年1月29日。

尊敬的上校：

此致

敬礼

〔此处转录不清〕

G.M.R. Halland 中校，O.B.E.勋衔，

SECRET

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. L. Q. D. 752
Date 11 - 12 - 29

H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai,
10th December 1929.

My dear Alks,

I should be very grateful if you would kindly let me know
the aims of the "Far Eastern Information Bureau Bulletin" of Nanking,
and who are responsible for its publication. Any further information
of interest that you may be able to collect with regard to its publication
will also be welcome.

Yours sincerely,

C.H.R. Hallard

R.C. Alks Esq.,
Director of Criminal Investigation,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

Foreign Section,
For investigation
and report please.
〔签名〕
11/12/29

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处档案室
编号 L. Q. D. 752
日期 29年12月11日

英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海，
1929年12月10日。

亲爱的 Alks：

如蒙告知南京《远东情报局公报》的宗旨及其出版负责人，我将不胜感激。若您能收集到有关该出版物的其他感兴趣的信息，亦欢迎提供。

此致

敬礼

C.H.R. Hallard

R.C. Alks 先生，
刑事调查处处长，
上海工部局，
上海。

外侨科，
请予调查并报告。
〔签名〕
29年12月11日
